en.headline: Taxi spins on wet Lung Cheung Road flyover and hits motorcycle
en.dek: The rider was taken to hospital after the late-night crash near Choi Hung Estate; some lanes on the flyover were closed for a time.
body: A taxi spun on a wet stretch of the Lung Cheung Road flyover near Choi Hung Estate late on Wednesday and struck a motorcycle. The incident was reported at about 11.23 p.m., shortly before the Observatory reissued an Amber Rainstorm Warning.

Local reports said the taxi, which was not carrying a passenger, lost grip at a bend and turned around. The motorcyclist was thrown off and taken to hospital. Accounts differed on whether the taxi driver was also hurt.
The Transport Department said some lanes on the flyover in both directions near Choi Hung Estate were closed after the crash, leaving remaining lanes busy. Police are investigating the cause.

zh.headline: 龍翔道天橋的士天雨路滑打轉 撞電單車鐵騎士送院
zh.dek: 周三近午夜彩虹邸對開天橋彎位發生車禍，運輸署一度封閉來回部分行車線；警方正調查意外起因。
body: 一輛的士周三晚上約11時23分在龍翔道天橋近彩虹邸對開失控打轉，撞及一輛電單車。事發時天雨路滑，天文台其後再發出黃色暴雨警告。
報道指肇事的士當時沒有載客，在彎位蹺胎後掉頭，電單車司機倒地送院。各媒體對的士司機有否受傷說法不一。
運輸署表示，龍翔道天橋近彩虹邸來回方向部分行車線一度封閉，駕駛人士須使用餘下行車線，現場交通繁忙。警方正調查意外原因。
